ORDER KS-33H10B050NN-Y24, the code the banked drawing is for (datasheets/mechanical/GATERON-KS-33-VENDOR-SPEC-DRAWING.pdf) and the MPN on hardware/cluster/key-switch-network/key-switch-network.kicad_sch. VENDOR CONTRADICTION - USE 60 M: sheet 6 states operation life 60,000,000 cycles min while sheet 3 sections 6.1/6.2 state 80,000,000. *** STRUCTURAL CONSEQUENCE, NOT DECIDED HERE: *** at 1.20mm the plate is thinner than either stiffening plan assumed, so ADR 0009's lamination-or-backer question is a REQUIREMENT rather than an option. description: Per key cluster: switches, one register (U-KEYS), its decoupling, and the per-key network
notes: Two - left hand (5) and right hand (6). The thumb clusters are on the main board (PCB-CARRIER, ADR 0017). The switches need a rigid PCB regardless (ADR 0002), so putting the register on it is nearly free: every switch-to-chip connection is a TRACE, and each key board connects to the main board by one 12-conductor IDC ribbon (CBL-CHAIN) into a through-hole right-angle J-CHAIN on its underside (ADR 0017)
